PILLARS.title: SOC 2 Type II Certified
PILLARS.body: SynTract Labs has completed SOC 2 Type II certification. Our controls for security, availability, and confidentiality are independently audited on an ongoing basis.

PILLARS.title: Data Encryption
PILLARS.body: All data is encrypted in transit using TLS 1.2+ and at rest using AES-256. Encryption keys are managed through a dedicated key management service.

PILLARS.title: Access Controls
PILLARS.body: Role-based access controls (RBAC) are enforced across all internal systems. Least-privilege principles apply to every service account and employee.

PILLARS.title: Infrastructure Security
PILLARS.body: Our infrastructure runs on hardened cloud environments with network segmentation, intrusion detection, and automated vulnerability scanning.

PILLARS.title: Audit Logging
PILLARS.body: All build jobs, API calls, and administrative actions are logged with tamper-evident audit trails. Logs are retained for a minimum of 12 months.

PILLARS.title: Incident Response
PILLARS.body: We maintain a documented incident response plan with defined SLAs for detection, containment, and notification. Enterprise customers receive direct escalation paths.
